summary_claims.claim: Decisions of public consequence stay under accountable human oversight; scale follows proof of impact
Government AI systems explainable, auditable and proportionate to risk
Coordinated national governance avoiding fragmentation and vendor dependency

scope.note: Existing record has no scope note; a declaration of principles for government AI use with accountability and auditability duties, included as core by the register's rules on intergovernmental and national declarations.

note: Targeted search for a later version: press reports and a 20 February 2026 press release (GlobeNewswire, not official) say the government formally adopted the declaration and asked the Pakistan Digital Authority for an AI supervisory framework. The PID release of 9 February 2026 (official) does not say this, and no official page was found, so nothing is added. Fields match the stored MoITT page.
